title: Corporations
body:
## Stromberg Inc

**Field:** Aerospace / infrastructure / everything-corporate bullshit

The big Corpo in New Bergen. The first megacorp to establish itself in New Bergen due to their aerospace programme. Almost the entire expansion of New Bergen into a metropolis have been funded by Stromberg. Stromberg is also responsible for the maintenance and growth of the Space Elevator and Starlight itself. While they specialize in aerospace, they have branches for almost anything. It's impossible to live in New Bergen without relying on Stromberg in some capacity.

_**Career Opportunities:** Aerospace engineers, propulsion engineers, pilots, flight controllers, orbital technicians, civil engineers, infrastructure specialists, logistics coordinators, mission planners, lunar operations, surveyors, construction crews, mechanics, security, corporate executives, finance, legal, communications._
## Biotechnica

**Field:** Life sciences / medicine / biotechnology

Biotechnica specializes in biotechnology, regenerative medicine, genetic engineering and synthetic biology, among other various things. Due to their impressive work, most ailments and illnesses can be cured and healed. Due to their advancements in medicine, many of the things we'd consider impossible today have been solved. Ear loss, eye sight and speech can be restored. Gender affirming surgery is routine. Broken bones can be regenerated. As long as you can afford it or your insurance can cover it. Biotechnica was funded in New Bergen. Stromberg Inc owns about 42% of the company. 

_**Career opportunities:** Bioscientists, geneticists, neuroscientists, physicians, biomedical researchers, tissue engineers, regenerative-medicine specialists, clinical researchers, lab technicians, biochemists, pharmacologists._
## SYNTEK

**Field:** Robotics / hardware / software / synthetic systems

SYNTEK is a company specializing in developing Androids. Their most successful product to date is still considered the SYNTEK-22N, but the controversy of the BIOSYNTH-7B have made SYNTEK skyrocket. Founded in Las Vegas, Nevada, they have an office in New Bergen. SYNTEK-22N was hugely important for the development and expansion of Starlight due to androids not needing oxygen.

_**Career opportunities:** Robotics engineers, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, software engineers, AI researchers, systems engineers, embedded developers, neural-interface engineers, synthetic-body designers, firmware technicians, field technicians, product designers, QA engineers._

## MetaLink LLC

**Field:** Telecommunications, phones, phone plans, IPS, Orbit (connection & dating app)

MetaLink is the major player in the US as well as in space for telecommunications. Besides selling and manufacturing phones and servicing both phone plans and IPS, they also make and maintain the connection (or dating app) called Orbit.

## True Life 

**Field:** Child welfare, child protective services, foster care, Engineered/Seed manufacturing

True Life is an independent partner with Stromberg for the ordering and well-being of Engineers.

## HoloLife Solutions

**Field:** Social media

Holo is the premier social media app. Created to connect Starlight with New Bergen, the Holo headquarters are located in the commercial district of Starlight these days.
